On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from collections import defaultdict
gi,go=G['Demo pair 3 input'],G['Demo pair 3 output']
h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
lines=defaultdict(list)
for c in set(x for row in gi for x in row)|set(x for row in go for x in row):
    if c in (0,2): continue
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if go[i][j]==c]
    # split into diag segments by color contiguity
    segs=[];seen=set()
    for p in pts:
        if p in seen: continue
        d=[(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]
        s=None
        for dr,dc in d:
            r,i=p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc
            if 0<=r<h and 0<=i<w and go[r][i]==c and (r,i) not in seen:
                seg=[p];seen.add(p);r+=dr;i+=dc
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=i<w and go[r][i]==c:
                    seg.append((r,i));seen.add((r,i));r+=dr;i+=dc
                if len(seg)>=2: s=seg;break
        if s: segs.append(s); continue
        s=[p];seen.add(p);seg=[p]
    for s in segs: print(c,s)
